propositions: Review gates currently read effective criteria and routing through multiple seams, allowing project disables or retunings to be ignored and activated project DET criteria to disappear; a single immutable CriteriaSnapshot must serve as the deterministic authority before any selection or model call.

Code-review project LLM criteria must validate applies_to as a non-empty list of non-empty repository-relative globs, where ["**"] selects unconditionally including when changed_files is empty, preserving prior ungated behavior while making the rule explicit.

The snapshot must compile effective built-ins, project LLM criteria, project DET criteria, metadata, and source locations with one deterministic digest reusing the existing _overlay_signature mechanism; contract tests must prove it yields the same selections as current behavior when no overlay is present.

The stricter non-empty-glob rule applies only to code_review project criteria at snapshot-compile time; the shared _validate_applies_to validator remains unchanged to prevent regression in plan-review and other gates that permit empty applies_to lists.

Nonmatching scoped globs must record a typed non-applicable selection reason without executing the criterion; built-in secondary-trigger semantics and plan-review routing must not adopt the code-review applicability rule.
